results.notes: Session B scope (unsaved wizard, pool unchanged): Decathlon (decathlon.com), markets United Kingdom - English (EN) + France - French (FR), AI Insights English (EN); categories Sporting Goods (discovered, C1) + 6 custom (Running Shoes, Cycling Equipment, Camping Gear, Swimwear, Fitness Equipment, Ski Equipment) = 2 x (10 Brand Image + 7 x 30) = 440 suggested prompts. Free slots = P - U = 1000 - 570 = 430, so 440 ticked = 10 over: the same over-pool state as the CSV "40 ticked, pool U + 30" without any back-office change. Ring values therefore read U + 440 / P (1010 / 1000) instead of U + 40 / U + 30. (wizard.pool.overWizard_other), Review & Launch disabled. Untick 10 prompts one by one (GB (EN) Brand Image rows): after 9 unticks "1001 / 1000 · 431 selected", "1 prompt over. ..." (overWizard_one, singular correct). After the 10th: ring "1000 / 1000 prompts · 430 selected" (= U + 430 / P, the limit), data-status "atLimit", amber stroke #F59E0B, amber label and message "Pool full. Any prompt you add must be balanced by an untick before launch." (wizard.pool.atLimitWizard). Popover: "1000 of 1000 · at the limit" (summaryAtLimit), In use by other analyses 570, Kept in this analysis 430, Free in the pool 0, "Need more room? Contact your account manager." (wizard.pool.needMoreRoom). Review & Launch enabled, Add prompt enabled.

results.title: In Manage Scope ticking or adding a prompt still needs room in the pool
results.skip_reason: state-changing action not allowed (user decision): the Given needs the pool of QA-GEO set to U in the back office (no free slot; today 430 free), and the Then step asks to untick a kept prompt and Save in Manage Scope of an existing analysis. The no-room state cannot be reached in Manage Scope without the back office (an unsaved Manage Scope edit would need more than 430 ticked suggestions on one analysis).
